# ProcessCredito

Auto-generated Ruby on Rails + Sidekiq project for BPMN process `Process_Credito` (Solicitud de crédito).

## Setup

```bash
cp .env.example .env
bundle install
bundle exec rspec
```

## Running with Sidekiq (HTTP Service Tasks)

HTTP service tasks whose output is not read by downstream nodes are enqueued via Sidekiq (`perform_async`). Make sure Redis is running and start both Rails and the Sidekiq worker:

```bash
redis-server
bundle exec sidekiq -C config/sidekiq.yml
bundle exec rails server
```

## Endpoint

- `GET /health`
- `POST /workflows/process_credito/execute`

class WorkflowsController < ApplicationController
  def health
    render json: { status: "ok", workflow: "Process_Credito" }
  end

  def execute
    payload = params.fetch(:payload, params.except(:controller, :action)).to_unsafe_h
    result = Workflows::ProcessCreditoWorkflow.call(payload)
    render json: result, status: :ok
  end
end

require "net/http"
require "uri"
require "json"

module Jobs
  class ConsultarScoreHttpJob
    include Sidekiq::Job

    sidekiq_options queue: :default, retry: 3

    ENDPOINT_URL = ENV.fetch("CONSULTAR_SCORE_HTTP_JOB_URL", "https://api.example.com/score")
    HTTP_METHOD = "POST"
    OPEN_TIMEOUT = ENV.fetch("HTTP_OPEN_TIMEOUT", "5").to_i
    READ_TIMEOUT = ENV.fetch("HTTP_READ_TIMEOUT", "15").to_i
    DEFAULT_HEADERS = { "Content-Type" => "application/json" }.freeze

    def perform(context = {})
      ctx = context.transform_keys(&:to_sym)
      uri = URI.parse(ENDPOINT_URL)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = (uri.scheme == "https")
      http.open_timeout = OPEN_TIMEOUT
      http.read_timeout = READ_TIMEOUT

      headers = DEFAULT_HEADERS.dup
      auth_token = ENV["CONSULTAR_SCORE_HTTP_JOB_AUTH_TOKEN"]
      headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{auth_token}" if auth_token && !auth_token.empty?

      request_class = Net::HTTP.const_get(HTTP_METHOD.capitalize)
      request = request_class.new(uri.request_uri, headers)
      payload = {
          "cliente" => ctx[:cliente]
      }
      request.body = JSON.generate(payload)

      response = http.request(request)
      parsed_body = JSON.parse(response.body) rescue response.body
      ctx[:score] = parsed_body
      ctx
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# Auto-generated by SHTLNG FlowSpec -> Ruby on Rails Compiler
# Process ID: Process_Credito (Solicitud de crédito)

module Workflows
  class ProcessCreditoWorkflow
    attr_reader :context, :visited_nodes, :enqueued_jobs

    MAX_STEPS = 100

    def self.call(initial_context = {})
      new(initial_context).call
    end

    def initialize(initial_context = {})
      @context = initial_context.transform_keys(&:to_sym)
      @visited_nodes = []
      @enqueued_jobs = []
      @join_arrivals = Hash.new(0)
    end

    def call
      queue = [:start_1]
      steps = 0

      while (current_node = queue.shift) && steps < MAX_STEPS
        steps += 1
        @visited_nodes << current_node.to_s
        next_nodes = dispatch_node(current_node)
        queue.concat(Array(next_nodes))
      end

      {
        completed: true,
        status: @enqueued_jobs.empty? ? "completed" : "enqueued",
        visited_nodes: @visited_nodes,
        enqueued_jobs: @enqueued_jobs,
        context: @context
      }
    end

    private

    def dispatch_node(node_id)
      case node_id
      when :start_1
        execute_start1
      when :task_1
        execute_task1
      when :task_2
        execute_task2
      when :task_3
        execute_task3
      when :decision_1
        execute_decision1
      when :task_4
        execute_task4
      when :task_5
        execute_task5
      when :end_1
        execute_end1
      when :end_2
        execute_end2
      else
        raise ArgumentError, "Unknown workflow node: #{node_id}"
      end
    end

    # [start] Solicitud recibida (start_1)
    def execute_start1
      [:task_1]
    end

    # [user_task] Registrar solicitud (task_1)
    def execute_task1
      form = Forms::RegistrarSolicitudForm.new(@context.slice(:monto, :cliente))
      form.validate!
      [:task_2]
    end

    # [service_task] Consultar score (task_2)
    def execute_task2
      jid = Jobs::ConsultarScoreHttpJob.perform_async(@context.transform_keys(&:to_s))
      @enqueued_jobs << { node_id: "task_2", job_class: "Jobs::ConsultarScoreHttpJob", jid: jid }
      [:task_3]
    end

    # [business_rule_task] Evaluar riesgo (task_3)
    def execute_task3
      @context[:riesgo] = Services::Decisions::RiesgoCreditoDecisionService.evaluate(@context)
      [:decision_1]
    end

    # [exclusive_gateway] ¿Riesgo bajo? (decision_1)
    def execute_decision1
      if ((@context[:riesgo] < 50) && (@context[:monto] <= 1000))
        [:task_4]
      else
        [:task_5]
      end
    end

    # [service_task] Aprobar crédito (task_4)
    def execute_task4
      @context = Services::AprobarCreditoService.call(@context)
      [:end_1]
    end

    # [service_task] Notificar rechazo (task_5)
    def execute_task5
      jid = Jobs::NotificarRechazoHttpJob.perform_async(@context.transform_keys(&:to_s))
      @enqueued_jobs << { node_id: "task_5", job_class: "Jobs::NotificarRechazoHttpJob", jid: jid }
      [:end_2]
    end

    # [end] Aprobado (end_1)
    def execute_end1
      []
    end

    # [end] Rechazado (end_2)
    def execute_end2
      []
    end
  end
end

  describe ".call" do
    let(:sample_payload) do
      { monto: 100, cliente: "sample_cliente", riesgo: 100 }
    end

    it "executes the workflow from start to an end event" do
      result = described_class.call(sample_payload)
      expect(result[:completed]).to be(true)
      expect(result[:visited_nodes]).to include("start_1")
    end

    it "reports Sidekiq enqueue status consistently when HTTP jobs run asynchronously" do
      result = described_class.call(sample_payload)
      expected_status = result[:enqueued_jobs].empty? ? "completed" : "enqueued"
      expect(result[:status]).to eq(expected_status)
    end

    it "supports formal execution trace #1 ending at end_1" do
      # Formal Trace: start_1 -> task_1 -> task_2 -> task_3 -> task_4 -> end_1
      expect("end_1").not_to be_empty
    end

    it "supports formal execution trace #2 ending at end_2" do
